# schema/session_login_cached — valid spec produces no diagnostics and exits 0
# No testserver needed; validate performs static analysis only.

exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
! stdout .

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

# Custom JSON login → cached token reused across iterations via the
# step-level requests[].cache block. The non-OAuth2 counterpart of
# auth.oauth2.<grant>.cache. Validator-surface coverage only — the runner
# does not yet honour requests[].cache.

state:
  fields:
    url:
      type: url
      default: "http://localhost:9999"
    username:
      type: string
      default: "admin"
    password:
      type: secret
      default: "test-password"

defaults:
  base_url: {ref: state.url}

# Bearer auth re-uses the cached token slot (state.session_token), which is
# auto-registered as a runtime field by the cache: block on the login step.
auth:
  bearer:
    token: {ref: state.session_token}

requests:
  - id: login
    method: POST
    path: /api/v1/login
    body:
      json:
        username: {ref: state.username}
        password: {ref: state.password}
    extract:
      - name: access_token
        path: access_token
    cache:
      store_in: session_token
      expiry_field: expires_in
      expiry_buffer: 60s
      expiry_format: duration

  - id: events
    method: GET
    path: /api/v1/events
    produces_events: true

response:
  decode: json
  events_at: events

pagination:
  none: {}

progress:
  latest_event_timestamp:
    event_time:
      path: timestamp

error:
  mode: standard
